sky-background.name: sky-background
sky-background.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game background, landscape 16:9. Use the supplied approved Clone Rush candy sky concepts as style reference. Render ONLY the distant sky scenery: radiant azure blue sky, fluffy soft white clouds, distant floating blue rock islands with bright green foliage and pastel pink/yellow/cyan rounded candy towers, delicate turquoise waterfalls. Soft atmospheric depth, glossy polished family-friendly 3D mobile game art. Keep the central 70% quiet clear sky with delicate far clouds; most islands along the far edges and lower corners, strongly softened by distance. All scenery is far behind gameplay. No foreground platforms, no foreground floor, no characters, portals, text, logo, buttons or interface. Full bleed opaque, high quality landscape.

floating-portals-v1.intent: Generate a new transparent sprite atlas using the approved standing portals as style reference.
floating-portals-v1.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for Clone Rush Candy Sky Phaser platform game. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its glossy toy-like blue and pink magic materials, soft white cloud puffs and bright polished highlights. Create TWO NEW FREE-FLOATING PORTAL RINGS, genuinely transparent background, arranged side by side in equal 768x1024 cells on a 1536x1024 canvas. Left ring cyan/royal blue reusable portal; right ring magenta/pink single-use portal. Each ring centered precisely at the center of its own cell (384,512 left, 1152,512 right). Each is a CLOSED CIRCULAR self-contained toroidal magical ring facing the viewer straight on, outer diameter about 580 pixels and inner opening diameter about 430 pixels. CLEAR FLOATING SILHOUETTE: no feet, no pedestal, no platform, no bottom plinth, no flat base, no gravity-dependent top ornament, no supports, no chains. Symmetric ring with small rounded candy-like segments, tiny white cloud-like puffs evenly on four diagonals, and 4-6 small energy beads floating around the perimeter within a 660 pixel diameter. Transparent empty opening so the game can render its existing animated vortex behind it. Keep highlights on the ring, a narrow cyan or pink emissive inner edge, minimal controlled glow confined close to the rim, clean alpha edges. Both rings equal size, same front view and shape; only material color differs. No floor shadow. No sky, no ground, no scenery, no text, no labels, no watermark, no rectangles or grid. The new rings must clearly read as intentionally levitating magical gates, unlike the reference portal doors that have feet. Transparent canvas around the complete sprites and inside openings; ample empty margins in each cell.
floating-portals-v1.note: Aperture centers measured from opaque inner rim bounds. The image is copied unchanged; origins align openings to the existing sensor centers.
